turns.reply: The fix works: with markup disabled on the console, the error message is now rendered as markup. I'll submit the patch.

Prompt validation errors now render their markup even when the console has markup disabled globally: `InvalidResponse.__rich__` in `rich/prompt.py` parses string messages with `Text.from_markup`. I checked this with an inline script (a console with `markup=False` printed `bad input` with the `[bold red]` tags removed); I did not run the repository's test files.
